Medir o problema antes do teste, por esc: Measure the problem before the test, by school or class: without a baseline, there is no way to know whether AI helped.
Completar a linha de base com dados medi: Complete the baseline with measured data from the test schools before starting.
Comparar ao menos uma alternativa sem IA: Compare at least one option without AI, on cost and expected outcome, before deciding to buy.
Começar por uma prova de conceito, como: Start with a proof of concept, as the answers indicate, before involving schools and students.
Começar por um piloto em poucas escolas,: Start with a pilot in a few schools, with success and stopping criteria set in advance.
Rever a escolha do piloto: pelas respost: Review the choice of a pilot: based on the answers, a proof of concept should come first.
As respostas já permitem um piloto: mant: The answers already allow a pilot: keep the proof of concept only if there is a technical question to settle.
Fazer uma consulta ao mercado e uma prov: Run a market consultation and a proof of concept to choose the technology before any pilot.
Listar os custos que a gratuidade não co: List the costs that free access does not cover and only defers: training, integration, data protection and support (Krueger and Jackson, 2026, p. 7–8).
Acordar por escrito o preço e as condiçõ: Agree in writing on the price and conditions for when the free period ends, before the test starts.
Confirmar quem mantém a plataforma públi: Confirm who maintains the public platform, for how long, and what remains the school system's responsibility.
Definir o tipo de licença antes de contr: Define the type of license before contracting: who may use it, for how long, and what happens to the data.
Comparar o custo por licença paga com o: Compare the cost per paid license with the cost per person who actually uses it: unused licenses are waste (Krueger and Jackson, 2026, p. 3).
Rever a cada semestre as licenças sem us: Every six months, review unused licenses and cancel or reassign the ones left over.
Acompanhar quantas pessoas usam de fato: Track how many people actually use it and renegotiate the price if adoption falls below plan.
Exigir no contrato limite de gasto, aler: Require in the contract a spending cap, alerts and a monthly usage report, visible before the invoice.
Monitorar o custo de uso todo mês: cada: Monitor the usage cost every month: each use is billed and the amount grows with adoption (Krueger and Jackson, 2026, p. 6).
Verificar se o preço da plataforma que a: Check whether the price of the platform the school system already pays for changes with AI, and in what unit it is billed.
Definir quem vai operar o modelo aberto:: Decide who will operate the open model: if a single integrator does everything, the dependency just moves elsewhere.
Garantir no contrato que código e config: Make sure the contract states that code and configurations belong to the school system, with documentation and knowledge transfer to the team.
Exigir interoperabilidade com os sistema: Require interoperability with the school system's platforms and export of data and configurations in an open format.
Levantar dispositivos, internet e energi: Survey devices, internet and power in the test schools and include what is missing in the budget (Krueger and Jackson, 2026, p. 7).
Fazer um levantamento de dispositivos, i: Survey devices, internet and power in the schools before the test: in many school systems, this is the first cost.
Definir a supervisão humana: quem revisa: Set up human oversight: who reviews each output before a decision about students, with authority to change it.
Aplicar as regras de proteção de criança: Apply the rules that protect children and adolescents: age-appropriate use and families informed before the test.
Contratar por etapas: ampliar por grupos: Contract in stages: expand by groups of schools, with criteria for moving on, instead of the whole school system in the first year.
Formalizar por escrito o compromisso da: Put the other level of government's commitment in writing: amount, duration and what happens if it ends.
